texts: Any MCP client can read the live discovery surface: trending agents, the $THREE holder board with tiers, the site activity ticker. Five tools, free: npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/activity-mcp
Every ranking, tier, and event comes straight from the public three.ws API, so the model reads the same numbers the site is showing at that moment.
No key, no signer, no payment. Install it, point it at the public API, and ask.

issues.problem: The image and changelog describe the surface as 'trending agents and coins'; the post omits trending coins. Not false, but the copy and the screenshot are slightly out of sync on what the discovery surface includes.
issues.fix: Either accept the omission (safe) or recapture-free fix: 'trending agents and coins, the $THREE holder board, the activity ticker' if length allows.

editor.summary: Both factual claims pass verification, the three live API probes are green, the image shows the real package page and matches the copy, and the voice contract is respected with no tags, hashtags, or hype. Only a trivial mismatch worth noting: the screenshot also advertises trending coins, which the post omits; safe to ship as is.
